turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
Shipping address changes need to be handled over the phone so our team can securely update the address and take care of any tax or payment adjustments that might come with changing the destination.

Please give our customer care team a call as soon as you can so they can help with this:

Customer Care: (800) 820-0465
Hours: Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST

If you have your order number handy when you call, that will help them move even faster for you.
